I only start packages when they solve a problem I have already hit in programme research. Two are in public scope now.

## surveyflow

**Research data operations helpers** for survey and HFC workflows (ODK/Kobo-style exports, completeness, ID audits).

- [README / scope](surveyflow/README.md)  
- Related: [diaries systems](../projects/health-financial-diaries/index.qmd) · [mobile data collection](../posts/24-mobile-data-collection/index.qmd)

## ncdfinance

**Facility NCD financing analysis helpers** aligned with the Kisumu mixed-methods research (indicators, decision-space summaries, transparent scenarios).

- [README / scope](ncdfinance/README.md)  
- Related: [thesis](../research/thesis.qmd) · [decision-space essay](../posts/47-facility-decision-space-chronic-care/index.qmd)

## Principles

1. No real household or patient microdata in public repos  
2. Synthetic examples only until partners clear anything more  
3. Prefer small, documented recipes over framework bloat  
4. Ship when a vignette can re-run on a clean machine  

[Contact](mailto:nichodemuswerre@gmail.com) if you want to collaborate on either package.
